title: Theoretical Foundations of Placing Onion Seeds in the Seed Box of Planting Machine
content: Studies on how many onion seeds are placed in the wheel slot of the planting machine were carried out taking into account the center of gravity. The result is a system of equations that allows you to determine the probable number of placements in a slot. Based on the numerical solution, it was found that onion seeds are more likely to fall with a large surface area.
